brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly one finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, ideally 1600×900, PNG, opaque background.
Subject: the real basketball player Matt Costello (マット・コステロ), and no other people. Base his identity on the official portrait just viewed in this conversation: short cropped medium-brown slightly wavy hair with a subtly receding hairline, fair skin, blue-gray eyes, broad tall forehead, straight narrow nose, defined cheekbones, full neatly trimmed reddish-brown beard and connected mustache, solid square jaw, very tall muscular build and broad shoulders. Keep him recognizably Costello in expressive hand-drawn ink. The official portrait is a likeness reference only: never paste the photograph or copy its logos.
Style reference: the viewed approved B-culver-black-lime-v3.png, use its charcoal #151A18 and vivid lime #CCF43B palette, heavy Japanese headlines, energetic ink-and-dry-brush illustration, ivory highlights and orange basketball. Retain bold graphic economy and hand-drawn texture. Do not reuse that reference's player, words, numbers, date, jersey, or shooting composition. Do not use the ivory background of the second style reference.
Composition: place the ONE illustrated player in the left 43% of the canvas, shown dynamically from head through upper thighs, torso rotating slightly toward the right while making a powerful step into a post move, knees bent, orange basketball gripped in both hands at waist-to-chest height. Show his face in a clear three-quarter view. Both forearms, both hands and entire basketball must be visible, anatomically plausible and contained in the frame; leave breathing room above his head. Plain sleeveless ivory basketball jersey with simple dark trim, no words, no numbers, no badges, no sponsor graphics. Dramatic lime diagonal brushstrokes behind his figure; keep the right 54% clean for type. The image is an imagined basketball movement, not an actual game moment, not a depiction of a confirmed appearance, score or result. No hoop needed.
Typography: clean legible very bold Japanese sans-serif with restrained dry-brush texture, precise characters, generous line spacing. Use only the following exact text, no other text.
At the top, modest small masthead and date: "バスケまとめ" and "2026.11.10".
On the right above the main headline, medium white: "千葉J vs 大阪".
On the right, main headline on TWO lines, first ivory, second huge lime:
"焦点は"
"インサイド"
Below the main headline, readable white: "コステロがエントリー可能に".
Below that, a clear lime rectangular label with dark text: "試合前展望／起用は未定".
Along the bottom in a dark clear footer, fully readable small ivory exact label: "イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ".
Keep all text within 5% safe margins with no overlaps with player. Make the qualifier and AI label conspicuous and readable. No statistics, no win-loss score, no unconfirmed claim of playing or success. No logos, no photographic rendering, no photo collage, no crowd or fictional opponent, no extra limbs or fingers. Deliver a single polished integrated illustration and typography image.
